top_issues.issue: Scrolled content is hard-clipped at viewport edges: partial lines, half avatars and chip slivers show directly under the header and at the bottom of the settings dialog.
top_issues.evidence: chats: 'focus, never in a loop' cut at y~52 under the header divider at y=51; channel: reaction chip sliver at y~48; settings: checkbox cut at y~697; composer-long-draft: glyph tops at y~557.
top_issues.fix: Add a 16-24 px fade mask (surface colour to transparent) at the top and bottom of every scroll area, or snap the initial scroll so the first visible item starts at a row boundary with >=12 px top padding.

top_issues.issue: Channel post cards have inconsistent widths, so their right edges are ragged.
top_issues.evidence: Light channel.png right border at x=1251 (y=150), 1253 (y=330, 500), 1255 (y=620); left edge constant at 390.
top_issues.fix: Lay all cards out against one fixed column width (e.g. content_width - 2*0, rounded to whole points) independent of scrollbar presence or content; reserve scrollbar gutter always.

top_issues.issue: Composer's inner scrollbar is a solid text-colour bar that does not match the app's scrollbar style.
top_issues.evidence: Thumb at x=1166-1169 is #1b1c1f (light) / #e9e9ec (dark), 4 px; main scrollbar thumb is #747578, 6 px at x=1274-1279.
top_issues.fix: Use the same scrollbar style everywhere: 6 px thumb in #747578 light / #6b6d76 dark, 3 px radius, placed against the composer's inner right padding, hidden until hover/scroll.

top_issues.issue: Mention suggestion popup touches the composer and partly covers a message, leaving a dangling fragment.
top_issues.evidence: Popup bottom y~672 vs composer top border y~670; message text 'g > Incidents channel' visible right of the popup at y=633.
top_issues.fix: Anchor the popup 8 px above the composer (bottom = composer_top - 8) and give it the same 12 px radius/shadow as other popovers; consider widening it to the composer width so it does not slice through message lines.

top_issues.issue: Calendar detail pane is sparse and left-weighted: actions stop at x=1113, leaving the header's right side and the pane's right 165 px empty, and the detail has only two key/value rows.
top_issues.evidence: Header buttons right edge x=1113 vs window 1280; body card 394-1113; list title x=96 vs section labels x=82 vs pane title x=80.
top_issues.fix: Right-align header actions to the pane's 24 px inset (or align the whole header to the 720 px column and say so visually); add attendees and a time block to the detail card; align list titles and section labels to one 16 px inset (x=80) with the status dot hanging in the gutter.

top_issues.issue: Setup screen's composition starts 18 px from the top while all other auth screens start at ~120 px, so it feels crammed and inconsistent.
top_issues.evidence: Logo top y=18 on setup.png vs y=123 on signin.png; card internal gaps 12 px between paragraph, button and label.
top_issues.fix: Vertically centre the auth stack with a minimum 48 px top margin; scale the logo to 64 px tall on setup if space is short; use 16 px between the paragraph, the guide button and the first field label.

top_issues.issue: Settings dialog scrollbar crowds the account action and vertical rhythm varies by control type.
top_issues.evidence: 'Leave demo' right edge x=881, scrollbar x~893 (11 px); helper text 22 px under its checkbox, dropdown label 8 px above dropdown, checkbox 14 px under dropdown.
top_issues.fix: Reserve a 16 px scrollbar gutter inside the content padding; use one 8 px label-to-control and 16 px control-to-next-row spacing; 24 px before each section label.

top_issues.issue: Focus indication is inconsistent: the filter field holding typed text has a grey border while focused dialog fields and the composer get a 2 px accent ring.
top_issues.evidence: Filter border #7c7f87 (light) / #82858e (dark) at x=76; status/new-chat fields show 2 px #a5500f / #e88c3e.
top_issues.fix: Apply the same 2 px accent focus ring (#a5500f light, #e88c3e dark) to the filter field when it has keyboard focus.

top_issues.issue: Quick switcher shows 8 rows with no indication that more exist, and the footer is cramped.
top_issues.evidence: 9 chats in the list, 8 shown (Alan Turing, Hedy Lamarr missing); footer note baseline ~14 px from dialog bottom (y=650 vs 670).
top_issues.fix: Show a scroll fade or 'N more' line; give the footer a 1 px divider and 12 px top / 16 px bottom padding.

top_issues.issue: Light-mode surface tints are almost indistinguishable, so hover, quote, mention and selection states blur together.
top_issues.evidence: Hover row #eeeef0 on #fff = 1.16:1; selected list row #e4e4e8 on #f6f6f7 = 1.17:1; rail #ececee vs list #f6f6f7 = 1.09:1; card border #d0d1d6 on #fff = 1.52:1.
top_issues.fix: Use a clearer surface ladder: hover #f2f2f4, quote/code #ebebee with a 1 px #dcdce1 border, selected #e2e3e8 plus the accent bar; card border #c9cad0.

top_issues.issue: Dark-mode panes are nearly the same value, so the rail, list and content regions separate only by hairlines.
top_issues.fix: Spread the dark ladder: rail #0c0d0f, list #141518, main #1a1b1f, raised #26272c, so each step is ~1.1:1 or more.

top_issues.issue: Inter's wide hyphen visibly splits compound words and the device code.
top_issues.evidence: 'On-call', 'go/no-go', 'Sign-in', 'F4KQ-9TZW' render with ~2x en-space around the hyphen.
top_issues.fix: Enable Inter's contextual alternates/tnum or substitute U+2011 non-breaking hyphen with a narrower glyph; for the device code use tabular figures and an en space or no separator with 0.08 em tracking.

top_issues.issue: Hover tooltip overflows the sign-in card and covers its divider, with larger type than its trigger.
top_issues.evidence: Tooltip spans x=601-900 (card right edge 874), y=445-492 over the divider at y=460; tooltip text 14 pt vs button 13 pt.
top_issues.fix: Place tooltips below-left within the card bounds or above the trigger; use 12 pt text with 8/10 px padding.

top_issues.issue: Meeting chat leaves a large empty band at the top and spaces system lines unevenly.
top_issues.evidence: ~100 px empty between header (y=131) and 'beginning of the conversation' (y=247); 'Meeting ended' ~8 px below the previous message vs ~24 px for other system lines.
top_issues.fix: Bottom-anchor short histories without a large spacer, or reduce the spacer to 24 px; give every system line 16 px above and below.

top_issues.issue: Links use two styles: blue in chat, underlined body colour on the device-code card.
top_issues.evidence: Chat link #1f63c6 / #7cb4f5; device-code link body text colour with underline; paragraph leading 24 px around it vs 20 px elsewhere.
top_issues.fix: Use the link colour (#1f63c6 light, #7cb4f5 dark) everywhere and keep the underline within the 20 px line box.

top_issues.issue: At 760 px the side list keeps a fixed ~230 px and truncates most names.
top_issues.evidence: 'Katherine Jo...', 'Design rev...', 'Grace Hop...', 'Dorothy Vaug...'; Calls rows give 76 px to two icons.
top_issues.fix: Below ~900 px, hide row icon buttons until hover, drop the time to the second line, or collapse the list to avatars; allow names two lines in Calls.

top_issues.issue: Shortcuts dialog columns are unevenly spaced.
top_issues.evidence: Left descriptions at x=390 (~90 px after most chips) vs right at x=803 (~40 px); NAVIGATION/MESSAGES label-to-row gap 30 px vs APP 12 px.
top_issues.fix: Size each key column to its widest common chip and wrap the zoom row; use 12 px label-to-first-row everywhere.
